prompt: 哪一句搭配詞才是正確的？
options: The company made a huge profit last year.
The company did a huge profit last year.
The company took a huge profit last year.
answer: The company made a huge profit last year.

profit 的固定搭配是 make a profit，不用 do。
wrong.The company took a huge profit last year: take 不能搭配 profit 表示賺取利潤，要用 make。

why: make a profit 是固定搭配，表示獲利。
say: The company made a huge profit last year.

text: The new policy _____ a lot of criticism from parents.

wrong.caught: caught criticism 不是自然的搭配，catch 常搭 a cold 或 attention。
wrong.won: win 搭配獎項或勝利，不搭配 criticism（批評）。

why: attract criticism 是常見搭配，表示引來批評。
say: The new policy attracted a lot of criticism from parents.

prompt: un-、in-、dis- 這些字首放在 comfortable、possible、agree 前，通常有什麼共同作用？

wrong.表示過去式: 過去式靠動詞變化（-ed），不是字首。
wrong.表示很多: 表示很多的字首是 multi- 或 poly-，不是這些。

why: un-, in-, dis- 都能把字義轉成相反，像 possible→impossible。
tip: 字首 un- in- dis- 常表相反。

prompt: 哪一句用字才是正確的？
options: She made an effort to speak clearly.
She did an effort to speak clearly.
She took an effort to speak clearly.
answer: She made an effort to speak clearly.

effort 的固定搭配是 make an effort，不用 do。
take 不能搭配 effort 表示「努力」；take effort 反而是「需要花力氣」。

why: make an effort to V 是固定搭配，表示努力去做某事。
say: She made an effort to speak clearly.

prompt: 在正式報告裡，哪一個字比 get 更適合表達「獲得知識」？

wrong.take away: take away 是拿走，語意不對，也不適合正式語氣。
wrong.pick up the thing: 這樣太口語，也變成撿起東西，不是獲得知識。

why: acquire knowledge 是正式、準確的搭配，等於 gain knowledge。
tip: 正式語域：acquire 取代 get。
say: We can acquire knowledge from books.

text: Heavy rain _____ the flight, so we arrived late.

wrong.delaying: 句中缺少完整動詞，delaying 是 V-ing 形式，不能當過去式動詞。
wrong.delay: 主詞是 Heavy rain，且事情已發生，要用過去式 delayed。

why: 句子是過去發生的事，need a past tense verb：delayed。
say: Heavy rain delayed the flight, so we arrived late.

prompt: This is a substantial improvement. substantial 在這裡的意思是？

wrong.非常小的: substantial 表示大量或重要，與 small 相反。
wrong.暫時的: 暫時的是 temporary，substantial 沒有時間長短的意思。

why: substantial 指大量的、可觀的，常修飾 improvement、amount。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The medicine had a positive effect on her health.
The medicine had a positive effect to her health.
The medicine had a positive effect of her health.
answer: The medicine had a positive effect on her health.

wrong.The medicine had a positive effect to he: effect 後面的固定介系詞是 on，不是 to。
wrong.The medicine had a positive effect of he: of 無法表達對某事物產生影響，要用 on。

why: have an effect on 表示對……產生影響。
say: The medicine had a positive effect on her health.

prompt: 你想形容一個問題造成許多爭論，哪個字最適合？

wrong.comfortable: comfortable 是舒適的，不能形容引發爭論的議題。
wrong.predictable: predictable 是可預測的，與引起爭論無關。

why: controversial 指會引起爭議的，常形容議題、決定。

text: Poor planning can _____ serious problems later.

wrong.give up to: give up 是放棄，沒有 give up to 這個表示引起的片語。
wrong.give in on: give in 是讓步，不表示導致。

why: give rise to 是引起、導致的意思，後面接結果。
say: Poor planning can give rise to serious problems later.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The inevitable result was a delay.
The inevitably result was a delay.
The inevitability result was a delay.
answer: The inevitable result was a delay.

inevitably 是副詞，不能修飾名詞 result，要用形容詞。
inevitability 是名詞，不能直接當形容詞修飾 result。

why: 名詞 result 前面要用形容詞 inevitable。
tip: 形容詞修飾名詞，副詞修飾動詞。
say: The inevitable result was a delay.
